## Summary
A clear one-line description of the feature or improvement.

## Problem it solves
What frustration or gap does this address? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution
Describe your preferred implementation approach. Include mockups or examples if helpful.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Scope
- [ ] New content page
- [ ] UX / interaction improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Mobile / responsive fix
- [ ] Visual / design polish
- [ ] Developer tooling / CI
- [ ] Other

## Additional context
Any other context, references, or related issues.
